intent.rationale: Private single-operator OSINT Research Center (research.mlnavigator.com). EXACT-email gate to james@mlnavigator.com only — deliberately NO @mlnavigator.com domain wildcard and NO bypass rule (spec section 22, ANCHOR.md). onetimepin (email OTP) is the login method; the owner-only allow policy restricts admission to the single exact email. The Worker independently re-validates the Access JWT (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, exact email).
